The pushin.eu provider covers [pushin.eu](https://pushin.eu), a European git host with an API modelled on GitHub's. The provider reads repositories, labels, collaborators, issues, pull requests, comments and notifications. The API's [OpenAPI specification](https://pushin.eu/api/v1/openapi.json) documents its endpoints.

::note
The pushin.eu provider is experimental. See [Capabilities](/concepts/capabilities).
::

## Authentication

The provider accepts a personal access token that you create in your pushin.eu settings. Tokens start with `pun_pat_` and aren't scoped to specific resources. The provider sends the token in an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header:

```ts
import { pushin } from 'forges/pushin'

const forge = pushin({
  auth: { type: 'token', token: process.env.PUSHIN_TOKEN! },
}).create()
```

Without `auth`, the provider reads public repositories anonymously.

## Instance

`baseUrl` defaults to `https://pushin.eu`, and the provider appends `/api/v1`.

## Issues and pull requests

`threads.get()` reads issues and pull requests. `threads.list()` lists both by default; set `kind: 'issue'` or `kind: 'pull_request'` to select one kind. `threads.comments()` reads comments on both kinds.

Listings use `Link` pagination and include rate-limit information from the response headers.

## Notifications

`notifications.list()` reads the authenticated account's notifications. Set `all: true` to include read notifications, or `since` to filter by activity time. Notification writes aren't supported.

## Thread events

The API has no timeline. `threads.events()` is `'emulated'` from the comment listing, and returns comment events only.

## Labels

`Label.colour` contains six-digit hex colours when supplied by the API. Named colours, such as `purple`, leave `Label.colour` unset.

## Accounts

The API reads only the authenticated account, so `users.get(login)` is unavailable.

## Webhooks

The API has no hook endpoints and no documented signature scheme. `capabilities.sources.webhook` is `false`, and the provider doesn't verify or translate deliveries.

`pushin()` contains no webhook code, so the provider has no `pushinLite()` factory.

::contributing{title="Record pushin.eu fixtures" to="/contributing/record-fixtures"}
```sh
PUSHIN_TOKEN=... FIXTURE_PUSHIN_REPO=pjullrich/pushin \
pnpm record-fixtures pushin
```

To choose the threads to record, set `FIXTURE_PUSHIN_ISSUE` and `FIXTURE_PUSHIN_PULL`. To record another deployment, set `PUSHIN_BASE_URL`. The recorder redacts `pun_pat_` tokens.
::
